inputs.goal: Job interview on Friday, worried about questions on my experience

scenes.teaches_native: check in and ask about waiting
scenes.topic_description:
Situation: You arrive at the company before a job interview and check in at the front desk. This is a short first contact before the main meeting. The goal is to identify yourself, confirm why you are there, and understand where to wait and what happens next.
Learner: Candidate. Partner: Receptionist.
Not in this scene: talking about your experience, answering interview questions, asking about salary or duties.
must_say: give your name — slot: the name
say which job you are here for — slot: the position
answer whether you have been here before — slot: the last visit (never, once before)
ask where to wait — slot: none
ask how long the wait is — slot: none
confirm you have the requested document — slot: the document
must_understand: asks your name and which position you are here for
asks whether you have an appointment or have been here before
tells you where to wait
says how long the wait may be
asks whether you have a document with you

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: You are in the main job interview on Friday with the person hiring for the role. Your main worry is answering simple questions about your past experience clearly enough to make a good impression and understand what the job includes.
Learner: Candidate. Partner: Interviewer.
Not in this scene: checking in at reception, waiting arrangements, handing over documents at the front desk.
must_say: say where you worked before — slot: the workplace
say what your job was — slot: the job title
say how long you worked there — slot: the length of time
explain what your main duties were — slot: the duty
answer whether you have used a tool or skill — slot: the tool or skill
ask what the main duties are — slot: the position
ask whether training is provided — slot: the skill or task
ask what the next step is — slot: none
must_understand: asks where you worked before and for how long
asks what your main duties were
asks whether you have used a tool or skill before
says what the job involves day to day
explains the next step in the hiring process
